main.description: Register a new feed in Gyoka.

uri.description: AT-URI of the feed generator record to register.

langFilter.description: Whether language filtering is enabled for this feed.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Returned when service authentication is required and the caller is not authenticated.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Returned when the authenticated caller is not in the admin allowlist.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Returned when request payload validation fails.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: Returned when the feed URI is already registered.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: Returned when feed registration fails unexpectedly.
